func TestMigrationPlanPGManagedOwnerCanonicalPolicyGuards(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMigrationPlanFixture(t, true)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_, err := f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER ROLE "+pgx.Identifier{f.owner}.Sanitize()+" CREATEDB CREATEROLE BYPASSRLS")
	planPGOK(t, err, "configure generated managed owner")
	for _, table := range []string{"contacts", "widgets"} {
		_, err = f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER POLICY rereply_migration_access ON public."+pgx.Identifier{table}.Sanitize()+" USING (false) WITH CHECK (false)")
		planPGOK(t, err, "tamper generated migration policy")
	}
	before := managedOwnerRows(t, f)
	db, state, err := openPlannedMigration(ctx, &f.cfg)
	planPGOK(t, err, "open generated migration pool")
	pool, err := db.DB()
	planPGOK(t, err, "read generated migration pool")
	t.Cleanup(func() { planPGOK(t, pool.Close(), "close generated migration pool") })
	reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	previous := os.Stdout
	os.Stdout = writer
	defer func() { os.Stdout = previous; _ = writer.Close(); _ = reader.Close() }()
	read := make(chan []byte, 1)
	go func() { raw, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, 1<<20)); read <- raw }()
	backfills := 0
	err = database.RunRLSMigrationCoordinator(db, &config.DefaultAdminConfig{}, f.runtime,
		func(*gorm.DB) error { backfills++; return errors.New("unexpected synthetic mutation branch") },
		func() error { return errors.New("synthetic verifier boundary") })
	require.NoError(t, writer.Close())
	os.Stdout = previous
	var output string
	select {
	case raw := <-read:
		output = string(raw)
	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("synthetic observer output did not close")
	}
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.Zero(t, backfills)
	require.Equal(t, "data-gate empty-phone-legacy-contacts error\ndata-gate empty-phone-mixed-sender-contacts error\ndata-gate empty-phone-missing-continuation-messages error\n", output)
	holdMigrationPlanLock(t, pool)
	d, ok := newPlanDeadline(ctx, time.Now())
	require.True(t, ok)
	work, stop := context.WithDeadline(ctx, d.workAt)
	defer stop()
	cfg, err := planObserverConfig(state.owner, planOwnerName, d, work)
	planPGOK(t, err, "configure owner observer")
	conn, tx, err := openPlanSession(work, cfg)
	planPGOK(t, err, "open owner observer")
	defer func() { require.True(t, disposePlanSession(d, conn, tx, false).complete()) }()
	self, err := readPlanSelf(work, tx, planOwnerName, f.owner, false)
	planPGOK(t, err, "read owner observer")
	held, err := readPlanHeld(work, tx, self, state.marker, f.owner, f.database, nil)
	planPGOK(t, err, "read real held owner")
	seeds, err := database.ObservePlanSeedsOnHeldOwner(work, tx, database.PlanSeedHeldOwner{
		PID: held.PID, DatabaseOID: held.DatabaseOID, DatabaseName: held.DatabaseName,
		RoleOID: held.RoleOID, RoleName: held.RoleName, Marker: held.ApplicationName,
	})
	planPGOK(t, err, "recover from unavailable canonical policy")
	require.Equal(t, "SeedDefaultWidgets", seeds.Steps[9].ID)
	require.Equal(t, database.PlanSeedIncomplete, seeds.Steps[9].State)
	require.Equal(t, "unavailable", seeds.Steps[9].Code)
	require.Equal(t, before, managedOwnerRows(t, f))
}

func TestMigrationPlanPGManagedOwnerAdmissionBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMigrationPlanFixture(t, true)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_, err := f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER ROLE "+pgx.Identifier{f.owner}.Sanitize()+" CREATEDB CREATEROLE BYPASSRLS")
	planPGOK(t, err, "configure generated managed owner")
	db, state, err := openPlannedMigration(ctx, &f.cfg)
	planPGOK(t, err, "open generated migration pool")
	pool, err := db.DB()
	planPGOK(t, err, "read generated migration pool")
	t.Cleanup(func() { planPGOK(t, pool.Close(), "close generated migration pool") })
	heldConn := holdMigrationPlanLock(t, pool)
	d, ok := newPlanDeadline(ctx, time.Now())
	require.True(t, ok)
	work, stop := context.WithDeadline(ctx, d.workAt)
	defer stop()
	cfg, err := planObserverConfig(state.owner, planOwnerName, d, work)
	planPGOK(t, err, "configure owner observer")
	conn, tx, err := openPlanSession(work, cfg)
	planPGOK(t, err, "open owner observer")
	defer func() { require.True(t, disposePlanSession(d, conn, tx, false).complete()) }()
	self, err := readPlanSelf(work, tx, planOwnerName, f.owner, false)
	planPGOK(t, err, "read owner observer")
	held, err := readPlanHeld(work, tx, self, state.marker, f.owner, f.database, nil)
	planPGOK(t, err, "read real held owner")
	owner := database.PlanSeedHeldOwner{PID: held.PID, DatabaseOID: held.DatabaseOID, DatabaseName: held.DatabaseName,
		RoleOID: held.RoleOID, RoleName: held.RoleName, Marker: held.ApplicationName}
	_, err = database.ObservePlanSeeds(work, tx)
	require.EqualError(t, err, "seed observation session unavailable", "generic API must stay strict")
	wrong := []database.PlanSeedHeldOwner{owner, owner, owner, owner, owner, owner, owner}
	wrong[0].PID++
	wrong[1].DatabaseOID++
	wrong[2].RoleOID++
	wrong[3].DatabaseName += "_other"
	wrong[4].RoleName += "_other"
	wrong[5].Marker = "rereply-plan-lock-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
	wrong[6].PID = self.pid
	for i, candidate := range wrong {
		_, err = database.ObservePlanSeedsOnHeldOwner(work, tx, candidate)
		require.EqualError(t, err, "seed observation session unavailable", "mismatched context %d", i)
		var one int
		planPGOK(t, tx.QueryRow(work, "SELECT 1").Scan(&one), "retain borrowed read-only transaction")
		require.Equal(t, 1, one)
	}
	duplicate := state.owner.Copy()
	duplicate.RuntimeParams["application_name"] = state.marker
	other, err := pgx.ConnectConfig(work, duplicate)
	planPGOK(t, err, "open generated duplicate marker")
	_, duplicateErr := database.ObservePlanSeedsOnHeldOwner(work, tx, owner)
	planPGOK(t, other.Close(work), "close generated duplicate marker")
	select {
	case <-other.PgConn().CleanupDone():
	case <-work.Done():
		t.Fatal("generated duplicate marker cleanup incomplete")
	}
	require.EqualError(t, duplicateErr, "seed observation session unavailable")
	before := managedOwnerRows(t, f)
	seeds, err := database.ObservePlanSeedsOnHeldOwner(work, tx, owner)
	planPGOK(t, err, "observe explicit managed owner")
	for _, seed := range seeds.Steps {
		require.Equal(t, database.PlanSeedClear, seed.State)
	}
	require.Equal(t, before, managedOwnerRows(t, f))
	var unlocked bool
	planPGOK(t, heldConn.QueryRowContext(work, "SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(hashtext(current_database()),1380270905)").Scan(&unlocked), "release generated witness")
	require.True(t, unlocked)
	// Restore before asserting so the existing fixture cleanup always owns its
	// expected lock. The observation itself occurs while the lock is absent.
	_, observeErr := database.ObservePlanSeedsOnHeldOwner(work, tx, owner)
	var locked bool
	planPGOK(t, heldConn.QueryRowContext(work, "SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock(hashtext(current_database()),1380270905)").Scan(&locked), "restore generated witness")
	require.True(t, locked)
	require.EqualError(t, observeErr, "seed observation session unavailable")
}

func TestMigrationPlanPGManagedOwnerRequiresDatabaseOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMigrationPlanFixture(t, true)
	for _, scenario := range []struct {
		name    string
		managed bool
		ownsDB  bool
	}{
		{name: "restricted_schema_owner", managed: false, ownsDB: false},
		{name: "privileged_schema_owner", managed: true, ownsDB: false},
		{name: "privileged_database_owner", managed: true, ownsDB: true},
	} {
		t.Run(scenario.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			attributes := "NOCREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS"
			if scenario.managed {
				attributes = "CREATEROLE BYPASSRLS"
			}
			_, err := f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER ROLE "+pgx.Identifier{f.owner}.Sanitize()+" "+attributes)
			planPGOK(t, err, "configure generated owner boundary")
			databaseOwner := f.admin.Config().User
			if scenario.ownsDB {
				databaseOwner = f.owner
			}
			_, err = f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER DATABASE "+pgx.Identifier{f.database}.Sanitize()+" OWNER TO "+pgx.Identifier{databaseOwner}.Sanitize())
			planPGOK(t, err, "configure generated database owner boundary")
			if scenario.managed && !scenario.ownsDB {
				managedOwnerDataGateRefusalProbe(t, f)
			} else {
				managedOwnerDataGateProbe(t, f)
			}
			db, state, err := openPlannedMigration(ctx, &f.cfg)
			planPGOK(t, err, "open generated migration pool")
			pool, err := db.DB()
			planPGOK(t, err, "read generated migration pool")
			t.Cleanup(func() { planPGOK(t, pool.Close(), "close generated migration pool") })
			holdMigrationPlanLock(t, pool)
			d, ok := newPlanDeadline(ctx, time.Now())
			require.True(t, ok)
			work, stop := context.WithDeadline(ctx, d.workAt)
			defer stop()
			cfg, err := planObserverConfig(state.owner, planOwnerName, d, work)
			planPGOK(t, err, "configure owner observer")
			conn, tx, err := openPlanSession(work, cfg)
			planPGOK(t, err, "open owner observer")
			defer func() { require.True(t, disposePlanSession(d, conn, tx, false).complete()) }()
			self, err := readPlanSelf(work, tx, planOwnerName, f.owner, false)
			planPGOK(t, err, "read owner observer")
			held, err := readPlanHeld(work, tx, self, state.marker, f.owner, f.database, nil)
			planPGOK(t, err, "read real held owner")
			owner := database.PlanSeedHeldOwner{PID: held.PID, DatabaseOID: held.DatabaseOID, DatabaseName: held.DatabaseName,
				RoleOID: held.RoleOID, RoleName: held.RoleName, Marker: held.ApplicationName}
			before := managedOwnerRows(t, f)
			_, genericErr := database.ObservePlanSeeds(work, tx)
			_, heldErr := database.ObservePlanSeedsOnHeldOwner(work, tx, owner)
			if scenario.managed {
				require.EqualError(t, genericErr, "seed observation session unavailable")
			} else {
				planPGOK(t, genericErr, "retain restricted schema-owner generic admission")
			}
			if scenario.managed && !scenario.ownsDB {
				require.EqualError(t, heldErr, "seed observation session unavailable")
			} else {
				planPGOK(t, heldErr, "observe explicitly held eligible owner")
			}
			require.Equal(t, before, managedOwnerRows(t, f))
		})
	}
}

func TestMigrationPlanPGManagedOwnerDoesNotAdmitPrivilegedRuntime(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMigrationPlanFixture(t, true)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_, err := f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER ROLE "+pgx.Identifier{f.owner}.Sanitize()+" CREATEDB CREATEROLE BYPASSRLS")
	planPGOK(t, err, "configure generated managed owner")
	for _, privilege := range []string{"CREATEROLE", "BYPASSRLS", "REPLICATION"} {
		t.Run(privilege, func(t *testing.T) {
			attributes := map[string]string{
				"CREATEROLE":  "CREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS NOREPLICATION",
				"BYPASSRLS":   "NOCREATEROLE BYPASSRLS NOREPLICATION",
				"REPLICATION": "NOCREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS REPLICATION",
			}[privilege]
			_, err := f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER ROLE "+pgx.Identifier{f.runtime}.Sanitize()+" "+attributes)
			planPGOK(t, err, "configure generated runtime negative")
			db, state, err := openPlannedMigration(ctx, &f.cfg)
			planPGOK(t, err, "open generated migration pool")
			pool, err := db.DB()
			planPGOK(t, err, "read generated migration pool")
			t.Cleanup(func() { planPGOK(t, pool.Close(), "close generated migration pool") })
			holdMigrationPlanLock(t, pool)
			observation := state.observe(ctx)
			require.Len(t, observation.incomplete, 1)
			require.Equal(t, "runtime", observation.incomplete[0].Component)
			require.Equal(t, "identity", observation.incomplete[0].Code)
			require.Equal(t, "rereply-plan incomplete", observation.line())
		})
	}
}

import (

// This regression uses only the existing loopback-only, generated PG17 fixture.
// It changes the generated owner, never the role/database in TEST_DATABASE_URL.
// Both observers must still reject incomplete facts; the test expects real
// successful observation, not a translated or suppressed error.
func TestMigrationPlanPGManagedOwnerObserverRegression(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMigrationPlanFixture(t, true)
	for _, managed := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "restricted_owner_control"
		if managed {
			name = "managed_owner"
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			_, err := f.admin.Exec(ctx, "ALTER ROLE "+pgx.Identifier{f.owner}.Sanitize()+" CREATEDB CREATEROLE BYPASSRLS")
			cancel()
			planPGOK(t, err, "configure generated managed owner")
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			var super, createRole, bypass, replication, ownsDatabase bool
			err := f.admin.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT r.rolsuper,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolbypassrls,r.rolreplication,d.datdba=r.oid
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r JOIN pg_catalog.pg_database d ON d.datname=$2 WHERE r.rolname=$1`, f.owner, f.database).Scan(&super, &createRole, &bypass, &replication, &ownsDatabase)
			planPGOK(t, err, "verify generated owner attributes")
			require.False(t, super)
			require.False(t, replication)
			require.True(t, ownsDatabase)
			require.Equal(t, managed, createRole)
			require.Equal(t, managed, bypass)
			t.Run("data_gates", func(t *testing.T) { managedOwnerDataGateProbe(t, f) })
			t.Run("planner", func(t *testing.T) { managedOwnerPlannerProbe(t, f) })
		})
	}
}

		var raw string

		planPGOK(t, err, "hash generated fixture rows")
		result[table] = sha256.Sum256([]byte(raw))
	}
	return result
}

# Catalog observations and production shape

The catalog snapshot records database structure for release comparisons. It
opens the configured runtime connection with startup read-only mode and captures
metadata in one bounded, read-only, repeatable-read transaction. It does not run
the migration coordinator.

## Known-identity equality

The released version 0 golden catalog defines the participating public
identities. Their normalized attributes, including explicit missing markers,
determine the catalog SHA-256. Participating kinds are relations, columns,
constraints, indexes, triggers, functions, policies, sequences, types and
extensions. SQL definitions and other free-form structural values are represented
by hashes. Relation ownership and grants use symbolic roles rather than live
role names.

Use the same golden-only identity set when comparing the first production
observation, O-1, with a synthetic database. Adding an overlay identity to that
comparison would change the question and invalidate the original equality
claim. Overlay-aware inventory is a separate check of the synthetic database.

The default command is:

```sh
./rereply catalog-snapshot -config config.toml -mode compare -seed-counts
```

Exit zero means that a complete capture was produced. Inspect `match` and the
known-object `differences` separately. A complete observation with differences
is valid input to the production-shape review.

## Count-only metadata

Unknown public identities are counted by kind. A dependent-object count may
name its parent only when that relation is already known. Non-public schema and
object names are omitted.

The count-only section covers non-public schemas, non-public objects, other
roles, default ACLs, OIDs, reloptions, statistics, tablespaces, other ACL entries
and other policy roles. These values are recorded separately from catalog
equality. Managed-service roles such as `doadmin`, provider ownership details and
default ACLs can differ between production and disposable PostgreSQL instances;
their names and provider-specific settings are not portable schema identities.
Two separate booleans report whether the migration owner owns the database and
the public schema.

Optional seed summaries use the committed global-table allowlist. The current
seed comparison reports the permission-key count and key hash. It does not
export key values, tenant counts or business records.

## Migration planner owner sessions

The `rls-migrate` planner and data gates observe the native migration owner
already held by the coordinator. A managed owner with `CREATEROLE` or
`BYPASSRLS` must own the current database and remain a non-superuser without
replication privileges. This supersedes the earlier planner design's
non-`BYPASSRLS` owner precondition and the implementation's additional
`NOCREATEROLE` restriction. Restricted schema/table owners retain their existing
observation path, including when they do not own the database.

Seed observation through `ObservePlanSeedsOnHeldOwner` independently checks the
coordinator's exact PID, database and role identity, canonical nonce marker,
and unique live advisory-lock witness before and after reading. Its observer
uses a distinct backend. Data-gate counts use the coordinator's own held
connection and verify its native identity and lock. Missing or ambiguous
witnesses remain incomplete observations.

The separate runtime role retains its strict privilege and visibility checks.
The generic `ObservePlanSeeds` API still rejects `CREATEROLE` and `BYPASSRLS`.
Read-only transactions, table ownership, grants, canonical tenant policies,
timeouts and connection cleanup remain required. Observation changes no data,
roles, grants, schema or seed state; it grants no mutation or release authority.

## Reviewing the production shape

O-1 must come from the accepted catalog-bearing production release. Retain its
release, image and golden bindings alongside the safe output. Hashes identify
differences; they do not supply SQL definitions. Obtain any necessary structure
from already reviewed source or a separately bounded structural observation.

Each known delta receives one disposition: `keep`,
`contract-cleanup-later`, or `fix-bootstrap`. A verifier-pinned delta is corrected
in bootstrap, rather than hidden by a production overlay.

Production-only object names require individual publication clearance. Objects
without that clearance remain in `accepted_unpublished` counts by kind.
`n_other_schemas` records the non-public schema count. The optional
`-list-unknown` output belongs in the owner's private review and must not be
copied wholesale into commits, CI logs or release artifacts.

The production-shape overlay is structural, idempotent DDL outside
`internal/database`. Its acceptance checks must establish all of the following:

- Bootstrap plus overlay matches O-1 under the original golden-only identity rule.
- Every recorded known delta has an explicit disposition.
- The synthetic inventory has no unknown objects when overlay identities are known.
- Applying the overlay twice leaves the same catalog.
- Read-only `rls-migrate` succeeds, and schema-change classification is empty.

Staging and compatibility fixture consumers must explicitly select the accepted

constraints, indexes, triggers, functions, policies, sequences, types and
extensions. SQL definitions and other free-form structural values are represented
by hashes. Relation ownership and grants use symbolic roles rather than live
role names.
